# Vendored Datastar

`datastar-rocket.js` is the `bundles/datastar-rocket.js` build of
[Datastar](https://github.com/starfederation/datastar) v1.0.4 (Datastar + Rocket beta.2),
MIT licensed (`LICENSE`), unmodified. It is embedded in the binary and served as
`/static/datastar.js`; the Starbase components import `rocket` from it through the page's
import map. To update, replace the file with a newer build and check the console in a browser.
